programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: While on suspension, police detective Nick Curran becomes romantically involved with a writer who may be a murderer.

programme.title: SNAG
programme.desc: An Australian lone wolf's quiet existence is shattered when he learns that the woman he once loved and thought was dead is alive and held captive by ruthless gangsters. Now, to take on this dangerous criminal organization, he must seek out allies and storm into a world of violence to rescue the love of his life in this gritty, modern day violent fairy tale.

programme.title: The Lookout
programme.desc: Writer-director Scott Frank, who scripted the screen adaptations of Elmore Leonard's "Get Shorty" and "Out of Sight," scores a winner with this gripping noirish caper saga. Joseph Gordon-Levitt stars as a bank janitor who falls in with thieves who are planning to rob his workplace. When he has second thoughts about participating, they ratchet up the pressure with threats to some innocent outsiders. Jeff Daniels, Matthew Goode, Isla Fisher, Carla Gugino, Bruce McGill, Sergio Di Zio.

programme.title: Outlaw Posse
programme.desc: When an outlaw learns that a fortune in Civil War-era gold was hidden by the Confederacy, he puts together a team to find and retrieve it. Learning about his plan, the outlaw's estranged son seeks out his father to get in on the job and try to restore his life to what it once was.

programme.title: Murder Company
programme.desc: As D-Day unfolds, a band of hardened American soldiers embarks on a daring mission. Tasked with sneaking a French Resistance fighter behind enemy lines, they must navigate the chaos of battle to eliminate a high-value Nazi target during World War II.

programme.title: The Last Voyage of the Demeter
programme.desc: In the late nineteenth century, the Russian schooner Demeter embarks on an unusual quest, carrying twenty-four unmarked crates from Carpathia to London. Their voyage seems doomed from the start, given their suspicious orders, as a malevolent presence preys upon each member of the crew. When the ship arrives, at last, in Whitby Harbour, the crew is nowhere to be found. The story is based on a chapter from Bram Stoker's Dracula.

programme.title: Killshot
programme.desc: A husband and wife who stumble onto an extortion scheme and enter the Witness Protection Program are hunted by a pair of ruthless killers in this taut adaptation of Elmore Leonard's best-selling thriller. Diane Lane and Mickey Rourke star. Thomas Jane, Rosario Dawson, Joseph Gordon-Levitt. Directed by John Madden.

programme.title: Judgment Night
programme.desc: A detour leads four friends into a nightmarish bout with drug-dealing gangsters. Emilio Estevez, Cuba Gooding Jr. Fallon: Denis Leary. Wyatt: Stephen Dorff. Cochran: Jeremy Piven. Sykes: Peter Greene. Rhodes: Erik Schrody. Travis: Michael Wiseman. Directed by Stephen Hopkins.

programme.title: Twisted
programme.desc: Ashley Judd is riveting in this atmospheric thriller as a San Francisco cop who has just been promoted to homicide detective. But her life begins to unravel when a couple of her recent lovers are found murdered and she becomes the prime suspect.

programme.title: Sleepy Hollow
programme.desc: Washington Irving's enduring legend gets a decidedly Gothic makeover in Tim Burton's hauntingly imaginative adaptation. Johnny Depp plays 1799 NYC policeman Ichabod Crane, who's "banished" to upstate Sleepy Hollow to investigate gruesome decapitations. And the locals are convinced that a tortured soul called the Headless Horseman is the culprit. Christina Ricci, Casper Van Dien.

programme.title: Sahara
programme.desc: An explorer and his sidekick search for treasure and help a doctor contain a plague in Africa.

programme.title: The Mexican
programme.desc: An inept criminal's girlfriend is kidnapped while he is in Mexico trying to pull off one final job.

programme.title: The Weather Man
programme.desc: Nicolas Cage shines as a gloomy TV personality in Chicago, where the highs and (mostly) lows of his stormy personal life may impact his chances of landing a dream job at the network. Michael Caine costars. Features cameos by Bryant Gumbel and Ed McMahon. Gore Verbinski directed from a script by Steve Conrad. Hope Davis, Michael Rispoli, Gil Bellows, Gemmenne de la Pena, Nicholas Hoult, Judith McConnell.

programme.title: My Boss's Daughter
programme.desc: Ashton Kutcher stars in this zany comedy about a hapless publishing drone who jumps at the chance to house-sit for his tyrannical employer because he thinks it will help him woo the man's comely daughter (Tara Reid). David Zucker directed. Terence Stamp, Molly Shannon, Andy Richter, Michael Madsen, Carmen Electra, David Koechner.

programme.title: The Switch
programme.desc: This delightfully offbeat comedy centers on a single woman who decides to conceive via artificial insemination. But seven years later, she reunites with a friend and comes to question the child's paternity after he recalls a last-minute mix-up involving the sperm sample she used.

programme.title: The Queen
programme.desc: Helen Mirren's Oscar-winning portrayal of Queen Elizabeth II propels this studied re-imagining of the royals' response to the death of Princess Diana.

programme.title: Nebraska
programme.desc: A devoted son drives his curmudgeonly father from Montana to Nebraska to collect a $1 million sweepstakes prize that the dad claims to have won.

programme.title: The Fifth Estate
programme.desc: The true story of WikiLeaks founder Julian Assange and his epic struggle against the US government over classified intelligence documents that were exposed for public scrutiny.

programme.title: The Sum of All Fears
programme.desc: Ben Affleck takes over the role of CIA überagent Jack Ryan in this adaptation of Tom Clancy's 1991 novel. But this time around, the author's familiar hero ("The Hunt for Red October") is an agency neophyte trying to stop a nuclear showdown between the U.S. and Russia.

programme.title: Only the Brave
programme.desc: Biographical drama telling the story of the firemen who battled the wildfire in Arizona in 2013.

programme.title: G.I. Jane
programme.desc: A woman trains to become the first female Navy SEAL while being sold out by a Texas senator who's being blackmailed by the Defense Department. Meanwhile, the aspiring SEAL suffers intense mental and physical anguish in the struggle to prove herself.

programme.title: The Dead Don't Hurt
programme.desc: In the 1860s western frontier, the fiercely independent Vivienne Le Coudy joins her lover Holger Olsen in Elk Flats, Nevada. But the Civil War tears them apart, leaving Vivienne to fight corrupt Mayor Schiller and his ruthless partner. When Holger returns, they must confront their changed selves amidst a landscape of love, betrayal, and the struggle for justice.

programme.title: Hell or High Water
programme.desc: Two desperate brothers commit a string of bank robberies in order to raise the money needed to protect their family farm from foreclosure. Meanwhile, an aging sheriff tracks the heists in an attempt to hunt down those responsible.

programme.title: Agent Game
programme.desc: Harris, a CIA interrogator at an Agency black site, finds himself the target of a rendition operation after being scapegoated for an interrogation gone horribly wrong. As the team tasked to bring Harris in begins to question their orders -- and each other --Olsen, a senior intelligence officer, and his subordinate, Visser, raise the stakes. Now, it's up to Harris and some newfound allies to uncover the truth and turn the tables.

programme.title: Long Gone Heroes
programme.desc: Ex-special forces soldier Gunner struggles to contend with the horrors he witnessed during his time in the service while reintegrating into civilian life. However, when his niece is kidnapped and held hostage in South America, he must return to the field to save her. Backed by an elite team of soldiers, Gunner soon discovers that his niece's kidnapping is part of a larger conspiracy that shakes him to his very core.

programme.title: The Machinist
programme.desc: An insomniac factory worker is involved in an accident at work and begins receiving cryptic notes at home and having visions of a co-worker nobody else can see.

programme.title: The Tuxedo
programme.desc: An action-comedy about a chauffeur who becomes a secret agent when he dons a special suit.

programme.title: Searching for Bobby Fischer
programme.desc: Moving story about the relationship between a chess prodigy (Max Pomeranc) and his overbearing father (Joe Mantegna).

programme.title: The Warriors
programme.desc: A Coney Island gang known as the Warriors goes to the Bronx to attend a city-wide meeting of all gangs; at that event, however, the psychotic leader of a rival outfit, the Rogues, assassinates the head of the city's foremost gang, but the Warriors are pegged as culpable, and they must fight their way across rival turf to make it safely back to their territory.

programme.title: Chinatown
programme.desc: Screenwriter Robert Towne won an Oscar for this film about murder and corruption in 1930s Los Angeles, directed by Roman Polanski.

programme.title: The Two Jakes
programme.desc: Jack Nicholson (who also directed) reprises his "Chinatown" role as PI Jake Gittes, embroiled in murder and real-estate corruption in 1940s L.A.

programme.title: Serpico
programme.desc: An honest New York City cop refuses to be corrupted, even though he sees practically all of his colleagues succumb to the temptations of the job. When he's finally had more than he can take, he goes public with what he knows about the negligent inaction of his superiors. Although this brings about a public investigation, it makes the talented office an even greater pariah among his co-workers.

programme.title: Once Upon a Time in the West
programme.desc: Sergio Leone's tribute to Hollywood Westerns concerns a mysterious gunfighter out for vengeance.
